confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Taipei price levels; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are the most reliable; hotel tiers, hostel rates, and July demand are less certain. Cocktail and wine are the weakest and were cross-checked against the beer anchor. The FX value comes from a web-search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional East Asian basis, loosely benchmarked to Seoul and Osaka for budget and midrange levels, with Taipei hotel rates set below Tokyo and Hong Kong. No single city was used as a direct comparable.
